designSystem.name: HematDaya Design System
designSystem.reviewStatus: draft, not owner-approved (per the system's own release record)

supply: selected Claude artifact (session design-system selection) -> files copied server-side into the Design canvas under project/ds/hematdaya/ with a designSystems record in project/canvas.json

filesCopied.project/ds/hematdaya/tokens.json: server-side copy of the system's project/tokens.json (feeds the canvas colour/text-style pickers)

tokenExport: tokens.json (Design System type list grammar); the system's export name is hematdaya-tokens/1

componentsNotUsed.name: HD.ScheduleWindows
componentsNotUsed.why: Its mode chooser has no editable windows; schedule editing composes ChoiceGroup + TextField(time) instead, with the same mode wording.

localDeviations.what: project/ds/hematdaya/tokens.css written by hand in this project
localDeviations.why: The system ships no compiled tokens.css; its consuming guide says to regenerate from tokens.json. Values and names are copied 1:1 (aliases resolved to var() references) plus the .type-* classes.
localDeviations.reviewImpact: Must be regenerated if tokens.json changes; not a system file.

localDeviations.what: project/app/app.css (scroll container, data <pre>, error list, key/value grid, 200% text class)
localDeviations.why: App-level layout not covered by a component; reads tokens only.
localDeviations.reviewImpact: Low; candidate for an HD layout helper.

localDeviations.what: Own markup for: scope-conflict energy block, split/partial-tariff cost, CSV row-error list, source catalog rows, schedule window editor
localDeviations.why: Component gaps: EnergyMetric/CostEstimate render 'Belum ada data energi' when a total is withheld for a scope conflict; CostEstimate cannot show effective-dated tariff splits; ImportPreview assumes file line = data row + 1 (wrong with blank lines or multi-line quoted fields).
localDeviations.reviewImpact: Recommend system changes: EnergyMetric/CostEstimate 'scopeConflict' state, CostEstimate split/partial tariff, ImportPreview fileLine field.

localDeviations.what: Copy differences accepted from the system
localDeviations.why: ImportPreview's primary button reads 'Impor N baris' (brief: 'Konfirmasi impor'); EvidencePanel headings are 'Yang teramati / Pembanding / Kualitas dan cakupan data / Yang belum diketahui / Saran umum' (brief: 'Yang tercatat / Dibandingkan dengan / … / Langkah pemeriksaan'); Disclosure label 'Detail perhitungan' (brief: 'Lihat dasar perhitungan').
localDeviations.reviewImpact: Product-owner decision: change the system copy or accept.

localDeviations.what: The whole app is one React component (window.HematDayaApp.App) mounted by x-import in each artboard
localDeviations.why: A stateful S01-S12 app with shared state and a shared calculation authority; the canvas format's markup-only screens would split state across artboards.
localDeviations.reviewImpact: Canvas elements inside the app are not individually editable in the Design editor.

checksNotRun: reduced-motion runtime behaviour (CSS rule inspected only)
non-text contrast of focus ring/borders measured in this project
missingBindingOrUnsupportedImport: No compiled tokens.css in the system (regenerated locally, see deviations).
React/ReactDOM from the system's components/lib are used only by the local standalone page; the canvas supplies its own React 18.
